title: How Corporate Organization Is Changing in the AI Era
excerpt: Enterprise collaboration is expected to evolve from humans assigning tasks to agents and receiving the results, to agents taking independent responsibility for task allocation and delivery within their authorized scope. Based on observations from internships, this article analyzes context, permissions, and human responsibilities, as well as the two types of competitors: strong model providers and existing enterprise collaboration platforms.
body: **I believe that in the next phase of enterprise collaboration, the approach will evolve from “people assigning tasks to Agents and then passing on the results” to “Agents defining subtasks within their authorized scope, finding collaborators, and aligning on delivery standards.”** This change will allow humans to reduce daily coordination efforts and focus on taking responsibility, defining permissions, and dealing with exceptions. To achieve this vision, it is crucial to have the right context and clear, enforceable boundaries for permissions. Market opportunities are likely to lie with two types of companies: strong model providers like Anthropic, and enterprise collaboration platforms such as Lark and WeCom. The former can work together to optimize models and task execution, while the latter have control over existing work interfaces, organizational structures, and enterprise services; reliable delivery of complete tasks remains a requirement that both types of companies need to prove. ## During internships, handover is still done manually In the development process I experienced during my internship, product managers could use Agents to organize requirements, while the development team employed Coding Agents to implement the features and conduct preliminary tests; Agents were also used for PR reviews. Although the way each role carries out its tasks has changed, the coordination and alignment between tasks still rely mainly on humans. After the product manager confirms the Agent solution, it is handed over to the developers, who then arrange for their own Agents to carry out the tasks. When there are gaps in information or misunderstandings, humans are still needed to get in touch with the other party. Employees act as both task managers and those who repeatedly assign tasks, provide additional context, and deliver results. As individual steps become faster to complete, this coordination work becomes more prominent and requires more effort. Therefore, my expectation for future collaboration between companies is that the Agent in the next stage will be able to determine, within defined goals and permissions, which subtasks are needed, find collaborators with the appropriate capabilities, and clearly indicate what has been completed. It should also be able to receive the output from others, identify missing information, and decide whether to proceed, retry, or return it to the person in charge. ## For autonomous connection with the Agent, the work standards need to be provided as well First, we can illustrate this with a scenario*“reducing the dropout rate in the registration process”*. After the product manager outlines the goals and business constraints, the Product Agent organizes these requirements, finds the development Dev Agent who can modify the relevant modules, and then determines the deliverables and testing standards. When developers encounter ambiguity in the requirements, they return the specific issues to the Product Agent so that tasks can be improved iteratively toward the goal; the testing Agent then verifies the results using the same set of criteria. In this process, the Agent can decide how to carry out the authorized tasks, but it cannot modify the business objectives on its own or expand its permissions. When it encounters conflicting requirements, needs to adjust the risk control rules, or plans to make high-risk production changes, it should defer the decision to the person in charge. ==blue|The A2A protocol has defined basic entities such as capability descriptions, task statuses, and outputs, providing a common format for different Agents to exchange information.\[1\] Decisions regarding which Agents to collaborate with, how to break down tasks, and whether sufficient evidence is available still need to be made by the models and operating systems==. Simply sending messages is not enough to ensure a successful delivery. As a result, people's work will also change. The managers of each business unit remain responsible for setting goals and outcomes, determining which tasks can be automated, and stepping in when abnormalities occur. Agents can handle execution and daily scheduling; organizations should not assign all responsibilities to the models. ## Claude Tag and DouBao Workmate are already moving in this direction ==blue|Claude Tag places the Agent in a shared Slack channel. Team members can assign tasks, provide supplementary materials, and continue working on the same Claude instance; with the appropriate settings enabled, **it can also proactively follow up on discussions and asynchronous tasks**.\[2\] ==This goes beyond a simple personal chat box, but sharing one Agent among multiple people is still different from multiple Agents discovering each other independently and coordinating their tasks. The official documentation for Doubao Work Partners covers team collaboration, allowing multiple partners to break down tasks, work in parallel, and hand over results, while enabling people to monitor the process and make corrections along the way. ==blue|The feature manual also describes how third-party or enterprise-built Agents can be integrated, as well as the distinction between task-sharing materials and the internal state of a single Agent.\[3\]\[4\]== What I’m looking forward to are more advanced versions of these products in the future. They will be able to select collaborators based on work requirements, define sub-tasks within their respective responsibilities, and pass on delivery standards to the next party. The current capabilities for sharing memories and handing off tasks already provide a certain foundation, but there is still a way to go before they can operate in a more autonomous and stable manner. ## The right context and permissions determine how far collaboration can go **The context should inform the recipient of what needs to be done at the moment.** Goals, effective decisions, and acceptance requirements need to be transmitted along with the deliverables; outdated conclusions and assumptions that have not yet been confirmed by a certain Agent should not be treated as organizational facts. Historical records can be stored for a long time, but only the parts that are relevant to the current task and for which access is granted should be retrieved each time. A company having a large number of documents only indicates that such information exists. The agent also needs to determine whether the versions are valid, whether there are conflicts among the requirements of different departments, and who to turn to regarding current gaps. Incorrect context can cause multiple handlers to continue spreading the same misunderstanding. **Permissions must actually take effect during reading and execution.** Agents claim to only be capable of performing certain tasks, and they cannot replace the authorization checks provided by tools and systems. After a task is transferred, it is necessary to reconfirm what the recipient can view and modify; just because the original owner has a certain permission does not mean that all collaborators can inherit it. The Claude Tag channel Agent uses its own service identity. ==blue|Channel members can request it to use the permissions granted to it, which may not be identical to each member’s individual permissions.\[5\]== Therefore, enterprises need to manage the combination of permissions for channel members and Agents, as assuming that sharing within a channel is inherently secure is not advisable. A sharing mechanism that is convenient in one scenario might increase the scope of information exposure in another. Only when these boundaries are clear can people reduce the burden of constantly monitoring progress. In case of anomalies, it should be possible to see what has been done and where the problems lie, allowing tasks to be stopped or resumed as needed. Autonomous collaboration and processes that allow for intervention need to be established together. ## I am more optimistic about these two types of competitors **One category is powerful model providers like Anthropic.** They possess planning, reasoning, and tool-use capabilities, allowing them to integrate models with context management and task execution into a single product. ==blue|Claude Tag indicates that model vendors can directly participate in corporate workflows through existing collaboration interfaces; while the collaboration platforms control these interfaces, they do not guarantee ownership of all the value generated.\[2\]== The opportunity for such companies lies in the fact that more advanced intelligent models can complete tasks more efficiently, and by using the results of actual tasks along with corrective feedback, these models and products can be improved, enabling the reliable completion of more complex tasks. It is necessary to distinguish between product scheduling optimization, the reuse of internal corporate experience, and model parameter training; corporate proprietary data should not be assumed to be usable as training resources for suppliers. The advantages of these models can only support long-term payment if they consistently result in less rework and lower costs associated with manual review. ^[But what concerns me here is whether most future tasks involving enterprise collaboration will really require such expensive models, and whether more affordable models—or even open-source models that can be deployed locally in the future—will be able to handle such key tasks.] **The other category includes enterprise collaboration platforms such as Lark and WeCom.** Employees already use these platforms for communication, and documents, organizational structures, and business processes are integrated within them. If an Agent can obtain the necessary materials within the existing authorization framework and deliver the results back to employees for further use, it can reduce the costs associated with migration and reconfiguration. User loyalty and comprehensive enterprise services provide these platforms with the foundation needed for deployment and distribution. Model integration is a necessary condition for this approach. Lark can optimize its products by combining ByteDance’s proprietary models with its partner ecosystem; WeCom’s official documentation also lists options for integrating DeepSeek, Hunyuan, and enterprises’ own models.\[3\]\[6\] WeCom’s current integration capabilities do not indicate that it possesses equivalent levels of autonomous multi-Agent collaboration, as the platform still needs to transform model capabilities into tangible outcomes in complete workflows. Platforms also have the capability to generate data feedback. Authorized task outputs, manual corrections, and validation results can help improve context retrieval and collaboration processes. Lark’s official stance is that team and enterprise private data are not used for model training; therefore, it cannot be claimed that “data similar to real business scenarios” can be used to train underlying models with customer information.\[3\] These two types of companies approach competition from the perspectives of model capabilities and enterprise entry points, and the competition ultimately boils down to one thing: which party can enable the Agent to handle complete tasks while allowing the supervisor to maintain effective control. ## Check if they really have done less coordination work To assess the value of such products, **it is important to consider the overall delivery time for the task, as well as the number of times manual efforts are needed to provide context, transfer outputs, and correct errors**. If employees still have to recheck each item individually, the benefits of collaborative work are limited, and increased use of models does not necessarily mean time savings. Companies have reason to adjust the division of labor, waiting until agents have reduced daily interactions and can pass on issues to the appropriate person in case of emergencies. While responsibilities remain, attention can gradually shift from handling tasks to making decisions about goals and managing permissions. This is the organizational change I hope to see. ## Key Sources 1. [A2A Protocol Specification](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/), capability descriptions, task statuses, and outputs. 1. [Anthropic’s Introduction to Claude Tag](https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-tag), shared channels, proactive follow-ups, and asynchronous tasks. 1. [Official Documentation for Lark’s DouBao Work](https://www.feishu.cn/content/article/7677519271848610746), product framework, team collaboration, and enterprise private data policies. 1. [DouBao Work Partner Feature Manual](https://aily.feishu.cn/hc/1u7kleqg/2t3efrzi), Agent integration, team tasks, and context hierarchy. 1. [Claude Tag’s Identity and Access Model](https://claude.com/blog/agent-identity-access-model), differences between channel Agent identities and individual permissions. 1. [Official Help for WeCom Intelligent Robots](https://open.work.weixin.qq.com/help2/pc/21663?person_id=1&searchData=), model integration, knowledge, plugins, and workflows. *The revision of this article and the verification of its content were completed as of 2026-10-09. Product capabilities are interpreted according to the official documentation, with the long-term vision for collaborative autonomy presented separately from the functions that have already been made public.* ---

3abb7dd2d81b22173321f26ba1ec01058da27e2d.translation: A organizational structure of humans combined with Agents

At the lower layer, QA, SRE, and Data Agents handle verification, operations, and data-related tasks.

5bf1dc69a529f7ff32c9029ddc338caa17fb54b6.translation: Humans are responsible for defining objectives and boundaries, while Agents complete handoffs, execution, and acceptance based on task contracts.

fbd2bc9f115a7bd7907fbf5eb57f4556154c57c0.translation: After the work unit changes from humans alone to a combination of humans and Agents, the organizational structure becomes two-layered. ab7970a6b2111ad4038113e2352fd528c221e04e.source: ## 正确的上下文与权限决定协作能走多远
ab7970a6b2111ad4038113e2352fd528c221e04e.translation: ## The right context and permissions determine how far collaboration can go

d105740e94b341bcde7cf1a8040f1c3fb4342752.source: **上下文要让接收方知道当前该做什么。** 目标、有效决定和验收要求，需要与交付物一起传递；过期结论和某个 Agent 尚未确认的推测，不应混成组织事实。历史记录可以长期保存，每次任务只应读取有权限、与当前工作相关的部分。
d105740e94b341bcde7cf1a8040f1c3fb4342752.context: 正确的上下文与权限决定协作能走多远
d105740e94b341bcde7cf1a8040f1c3fb4342752.translation: **The context should inform the recipient of what needs to be done at the moment.** Goals, effective decisions, and acceptance requirements need to be transmitted along with the deliverables; outdated conclusions and assumptions that have not yet been confirmed by a certain Agent should not be treated as organizational facts. Historical records can be stored for a long time, but only the parts that are relevant to the current task and for which access is granted should be retrieved each time.

4ae77bad457d136f3bf5a75be98a64ca5e2c59d9.source: 企业拥有大量文档，只能说明资料存在。Agent 还要判断版本是否有效、不同部门的要求是否冲突，以及当前缺口应向谁询问。错误上下文会让多个执行者把同一个误解继续传播下去。
4ae77bad457d136f3bf5a75be98a64ca5e2c59d9.context: 正确的上下文与权限决定协作能走多远
4ae77bad457d136f3bf5a75be98a64ca5e2c59d9.translation: A company having a large number of documents only indicates that such information exists. The agent also needs to determine whether the versions are valid, whether there are conflicts among the requirements of different departments, and who to turn to regarding current gaps. Incorrect context can cause multiple handlers to continue spreading the same misunderstanding.

d26864bcbed269a3a896f3c4f6f14b2dc30cce20.source: **权限要在读取和执行时真正生效。** Agent 声称自己只做某些事情，不能替代工具与系统的授权检查。任务移交后，接收方能看什么、能改什么，需要重新确认；原负责人拥有某项权限，不意味着所有协作者都可以继承它。
d26864bcbed269a3a896f3c4f6f14b2dc30cce20.context: 正确的上下文与权限决定协作能走多远
d26864bcbed269a3a896f3c4f6f14b2dc30cce20.translation: **Permissions must actually take effect during reading and execution.** Agents claim to only be capable of performing certain tasks, and they cannot replace the authorization checks provided by tools and systems. After a task is transferred, it is necessary to reconfirm what the recipient can view and modify; just because the original owner has a certain permission does not mean that all collaborators can inherit it.

530d1bdc634473fd719a37d8c7faafff8db7fb9a.source: Claude Tag 的频道 Agent 使用自己的服务身份，==blue|频道成员可以请求它使用已授予的权限，未必与每位成员个人权限相同。\[5\]== 企业因此要管理频道成员和 Agent 的权限组合，不能默认共享频道天然安全。一个场景里方便的共享机制，在另一场景里可能扩大信息披露范围。
530d1bdc634473fd719a37d8c7faafff8db7fb9a.context: 正确的上下文与权限决定协作能走多远
530d1bdc634473fd719a37d8c7faafff8db7fb9a.translation: The Claude Tag channel Agent uses its own service identity. ==blue|Channel members can request it to use the permissions granted to it, which may not be identical to each member’s individual permissions.\[5\]== Therefore, enterprises need to manage the combination of permissions for channel members and Agents, as assuming that sharing within a channel is inherently secure is not advisable. A sharing mechanism that is convenient in one scenario might increase the scope of information exposure in another.

eeebefdf76be41cfcbcda25bcd9319f3ac84aa77.source: 只有这些边界明确，人才能减少逐步盯着执行的负担。异常时还应看得见已经做过什么、哪里出了问题，必要时停止或恢复任务。自主协作与可介入的过程需要一起建立。
eeebefdf76be41cfcbcda25bcd9319f3ac84aa77.context: 正确的上下文与权限决定协作能走多远
eeebefdf76be41cfcbcda25bcd9319f3ac84aa77.translation: Only when these boundaries are clear can people reduce the burden of constantly monitoring progress. In case of anomalies, it should be possible to see what has been done and where the problems lie, allowing tasks to be stopped or resumed as needed. Autonomous collaboration and processes that allow for intervention need to be established together.

70bddb66ca06212e397e3fc68c44b6543c3e8b65.translation: ## I am more optimistic about these two types of competitors

5a1b34c9f505871906759d58cdd921aa35a3d3eb.source: **一类是 Anthropic 这样的强模型提供商。** 它们拥有规划、推理和工具使用能力，可以把模型与上下文管理、任务执行做成同一产品。==blue|Claude Tag 说明模型厂商可以借助既有协作入口直接参与企业工作，协作平台掌握入口，也不保证能拿走全部价值。\[2\]==
5a1b34c9f505871906759d58cdd921aa35a3d3eb.translation: **One category is powerful model providers like Anthropic.** They possess planning, reasoning, and tool-use capabilities, allowing them to integrate models with context management and task execution into a single product. ==blue|Claude Tag indicates that model vendors can directly participate in corporate workflows through existing collaboration interfaces; while the collaboration platforms control these interfaces, they do not guarantee ownership of all the value generated.\[2\]==

f58bfd55a8293a3a8c5ed41404f49dd41ed790a0.source: 这类公司的机会，在于更前沿智能的模型能更加高效的完成任务、以及用真实任务的完成结果与纠正反馈改进模型及产品，让更复杂的工作得到可靠交付。需要区分产品调度优化、企业内部经验复用和模型参数训练，企业私有数据不能默认转成供应商训练资源。模型优势只有持续体现为更少返工、更低人工复核成本，才能支持长期付费。
f58bfd55a8293a3a8c5ed41404f49dd41ed790a0.translation: The opportunity for such companies lies in the fact that more advanced intelligent models can complete tasks more efficiently, and by using the results of actual tasks along with corrective feedback, these models and products can be improved, enabling the reliable completion of more complex tasks. It is necessary to distinguish between product scheduling optimization, the reuse of internal corporate experience, and model parameter training; corporate proprietary data should not be assumed to be usable as training resources for suppliers. The advantages of these models can only support long-term payment if they consistently result in less rework and lower costs associated with manual review.

2136689a7dee43ef040afe795d1f3facc4731af7.source: ^[但是这里我保持担忧的是未来企业协作的任务大部分需不需要这么贵的模型，平价的模型甚至未来本地部署开源模型能否承担此类主要任务]
2136689a7dee43ef040afe795d1f3facc4731af7.translation: ^[But what concerns me here is whether most future tasks involving enterprise collaboration will really require such expensive models, and whether more affordable models—or even open-source models that can be deployed locally in the future—will be able to handle such key tasks.]

66cc72d3bd4649e4d130e746b1ccfafe8ba4c868.source: **另一类是飞书、企业微信这样的企业协作平台。** 员工已经在其中沟通，文档、组织关系和业务流程也已接入。Agent 如果能在原有授权下获得正确材料，并把成果交回员工继续使用的系统，就能减少迁移与重新配置的成本。用户黏性和完善的企业服务，使这些平台拥有部署与分发的基础。
66cc72d3bd4649e4d130e746b1ccfafe8ba4c868.translation: **The other category includes enterprise collaboration platforms such as Lark and WeCom.** Employees already use these platforms for communication, and documents, organizational structures, and business processes are integrated within them. If an Agent can obtain the necessary materials within the existing authorization framework and deliver the results back to employees for further use, it can reduce the costs associated with migration and reconfiguration. User loyalty and comprehensive enterprise services provide these platforms with the foundation needed for deployment and distribution.

fe6e6cfef771cb857f9d44077fa8acc7b3e02204.source: 模型接入是这条路径的必要条件。飞书可以结合字节自研模型和伙伴执行体系优化产品；企业微信的官方文档也已经列出 DeepSeek、混元及企业自有模型接入。\[3\]\[6\] 企微的现有接入能力，并不证明它已经具备同等程度的自主多 Agent 协作，平台仍要把模型能力转成完整流程的交付表现。
fe6e6cfef771cb857f9d44077fa8acc7b3e02204.translation: Model integration is a necessary condition for this approach. Lark can optimize its products by combining ByteDance’s proprietary models with its partner ecosystem; WeCom’s official documentation also lists options for integrating DeepSeek, Hunyuan, and enterprises’ own models.\[3\]\[6\] WeCom’s current integration capabilities do not indicate that it possesses equivalent levels of autonomous multi-Agent collaboration, as the platform still needs to transform model capabilities into tangible outcomes in complete workflows.

c315ced82b135c095b762e5002cb0457b5ba3198.source: 平台也有条件形成数据反馈。已授权的任务产物、人工纠正和验收结果，可以帮助改进上下文检索与协作流程。飞书官方明确表示团队与企业私有数据不用于模型训练，因此不能把“接近真实业务”直接写成“可以拿客户资料训练底层模型”。\[3\]
c315ced82b135c095b762e5002cb0457b5ba3198.translation: Platforms also have the capability to generate data feedback. Authorized task outputs, manual corrections, and validation results can help improve context retrieval and collaboration processes. Lark’s official stance is that team and enterprise private data are not used for model training; therefore, it cannot be claimed that “data similar to real business scenarios” can be used to train underlying models with customer information.\[3\]

d46061456f00cbecbefe8f6d05798e1dadfd35e6.source: 这两类公司分别从模型能力与企业入口出发，竞争会落到同一件事上，谁能让 Agent 接住完整任务，同时让负责人保留有效控制。
d46061456f00cbecbefe8f6d05798e1dadfd35e6.translation: These two types of companies approach competition from the perspectives of model capabilities and enterprise entry points, and the competition ultimately boils down to one thing: which party can enable the Agent to handle complete tasks while allowing the supervisor to maintain effective control.

d086d64701810af7e1471be0f412d9a04aeec990.source: ## 看人是否真的少做了对接
d086d64701810af7e1471be0f412d9a04aeec990.translation: ## Check if they really have done less coordination work

dd3662b008ef98615e08bbcdc294418d7efb6d89.source: 判断这类产品的价值，**要注意看整项任务的交付周期，以及人工补充上下文、转交产物和纠错的次数**。员工若依旧要逐项重做检查，自主协作的收益就有限，模型调用增加也不能证明节省了时间。
dd3662b008ef98615e08bbcdc294418d7efb6d89.context: 看人是否真的少做了对接
dd3662b008ef98615e08bbcdc294418d7efb6d89.translation: To assess the value of such products, **it is important to consider the overall delivery time for the task, as well as the number of times manual efforts are needed to provide context, transfer outputs, and correct errors**. If employees still have to recheck each item individually, the benefits of collaborative work are limited, and increased use of models does not necessarily mean time savings.

4a0194b876921ecfba17afe6c7e2c2349e0bb07c.source: 企业有理由调整分工，要等 Agent 已经减少日常对接，同时能在异常时把问题交给合适的负责人。人的责任还在，精力却可以逐步从搬运结果转向目标取舍与权限管理。这是我期待的组织变化。
4a0194b876921ecfba17afe6c7e2c2349e0bb07c.context: 看人是否真的少做了对接
4a0194b876921ecfba17afe6c7e2c2349e0bb07c.translation: Companies have reason to adjust the division of labor, waiting until agents have reduced daily interactions and can pass on issues to the appropriate person in case of emergencies. While responsibilities remain, attention can gradually shift from handling tasks to making decisions about goals and managing permissions. This is the organizational change I hope to see.

a053f457edd47854622df15d7665e6e9cc57c6b9.source:
1. [A2A 协议规范](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/)，能力描述、任务状态与产物。
1. [Anthropic 的 Claude Tag 发布说明](https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-tag)，共享频道、主动跟进和异步任务。
1. [飞书的豆包工作官方说明](https://www.feishu.cn/content/article/7677519271848610746)，产品体系、小队协同及企业私有数据政策。
1. [豆包工作伙伴功能手册](https://aily.feishu.cn/hc/1u7kleqg/2t3efrzi)，Agent 接入、团队任务与上下文分层。
1. [Claude Tag 的身份与访问模型](https://claude.com/blog/agent-identity-access-model)，频道 Agent 身份与个人权限的区别。
1. [企业微信智能机器人官方帮助](https://open.work.weixin.qq.com/help2/pc/21663?person_id=1&searchData=)，模型接入、知识、插件与工作流。
a053f457edd47854622df15d7665e6e9cc57c6b9.translation:
1. [A2A Protocol Specification](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/), capability descriptions, task statuses, and outputs.
1. [Anthropic’s Introduction to Claude Tag](https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-tag), shared channels, proactive follow-ups, and asynchronous tasks.
1. [Official Documentation for Lark’s DouBao Work](https://www.feishu.cn/content/article/7677519271848610746), product framework, team collaboration, and enterprise private data policies.
1. [DouBao Work Partner Feature Manual](https://aily.feishu.cn/hc/1u7kleqg/2t3efrzi), Agent integration, team tasks, and context hierarchy.
1. [Claude Tag’s Identity and Access Model](https://claude.com/blog/agent-identity-access-model), differences between channel Agent identities and individual permissions.
1. [Official Help for WeCom Intelligent Robots](https://open.work.weixin.qq.com/help2/pc/21663?person_id=1&searchData=), model integration, knowledge, plugins, and workflows.
